name: Kamikawa (Niigata, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kamikawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring with a mountain peak at the top enclosing the character 上.
history: Flag of the former village of Kamikawa in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01.

features.role: Kamikawa village emblem — an outlined ring with a mountain peak at the top enclosing the character 上
